The narrowed research endpoint is complete. In finite linearly ordered split graphs under induced order-preserving embeddings, the ordered edge has small Ramsey degree exactly 3. The proof includes the marked free-amalgamation upper bound, an explicit forgetful-reduct argument, and the unique-partition ordered P4 lower bound. For all ordered chordal graphs, only the lower bound 2 and exact free/PEO amalgamation obstructions are claimed; the original degree remains open. Referee, novelty, citation, exact-certificate, clean-build, visual-PDF, and extracted-release gates all passed.
